description: Control of the contagion net's data rule in JS: `'skip'` here is data — a constant, a table of cases, a parameter's default, a comparison, an argument. Functions are not containers (`statusOf`, `first` hold no string), and a normal call is an opaque frontier (round 7d): `kind` in `expect(statusOf(kind)).toBe(…)` and `expect(first().status === kind).toBe(…)` is an argument of a call, never part of a callee. No finding. The real runner runs the test.
